items.title: Service of process on Josh Davis — starts the response clock
items.rule_basis: FRCP 81(c)(2): in a removed action, respond within the longest of 21 days after receipt/service of the initial pleading or 7 days after removal. Removal was 2026-06-12, so effectively ~21 days after service.
items.source: Josh's email to Lewis Brisbois 2026-06-26: 'Still haven't been served.'
items.action: Every run: scan Outlook/Gmail/docket for proof of service on Davis. The moment service appears, compute candidate response date and RED FLAG until counsel confirms.
